entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Are you experiencing a technical fault, or is it more of a preference issue?
It just doesn't work for me. I tried to return it last week, but your website was broken.
I'm very sorry to hear that. You mentioned an issue with the website. Can you tell me more about that?
The whole thing was just a website error page. The system was down or something. I couldn't print the label, I couldn't do anything. I took a screenshot, if you need proof.
Thank you for that information, I appreciate it. Let me just check our system status logs for last week. One moment.

Okay, yes, I do see a note here about a service outage last Tuesday that affected our returns portal. My sincere apologies for that inconvenience. Let me pull up your order details. I see you received the VeloBand 18 days ago.
And you're perfectly fine. I'm just checking our policy, and it states that items can be returned within 90 days of delivery. So you are well within that window.
Fine. So you'll send me a label?
Yes, absolutely. I've just processed the return authorization for you. A pre-paid shipping label has been sent to the email address on your account. You should receive it within the next 5 minutes.
Whatever. As long as it works this time.

I understand completely. The email has a direct link to the label to make it easy. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
